text:
acme_prod_ops: Hey team, saw a p99 spike during an onboarding replay at ~11:02 UTC. Customers hit /v1/generate -> 504s and timeouts. Can we triage?
emma_support: Sorry about that — which customer, route, and rough RPS? Any repro steps?
acme_prod_ops: Route /v1/generate (model=redwood-large-16k). Burst ~1200 r/s for 30s then ~150 r/s. Repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"<long>...\",\"max_tokens\":512}' -H \"Authorization: Bearer ...\"
kai_oncall: Paging eng-sre + eng-platform. Observed attach queue jump and provisioning backlog at 11:01:55. p95 went 180ms->1.1s, p99 hit ~3.8s.
jordan_sre: Scaleups triggered but many attach attempts failed: \"no free GPU\" and image-pull backoff on nodes. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T11:02:01Z attach: pod attach failed: image pull backoff (5) -> retry
2026-03-16T11:02:05Z provisioner: alloc request queued (pool=dedicated-us-east-2-min)
2026-03-16T11:02:12Z warmup: kernel image missing fallback -> cold GPU start
```
maria_pager: Also KV cache init latency high on first token of new sessions. First-token p95 ~650ms vs baseline 40ms. Cold GPU starts are a big contributor.
emma_support: Customer reported intermittent 401s during the spike, but main symptom was timeouts/504s. Could be retry/auth expiry interplay if attach delayed.
acme_prod_ops: They were on reserved billing window; no auth rotation planned.
jordan_sre: Hypothesis: minpool reduction removed warm capacity -> simultaneous attach = thundering herd -> image pulls + kernel init add 1-3s per attach -> p99 spike. Also saw priority queue fanout.
kai_oncall: Was this pool recently trimmed for cost savings (INC-3571)?
jordan_sre: Yes, minpool for dedicated-us-east-2-min was reduced overnight. Likely removed warm nodes for predictable trial bursts.
emma_support: Suggested repro for eng: 1) Replay 1k r/s short burst hitting /v1/generate 2) capture attach queue via /internal/metrics?query=attach_queue_len 3) collect node events: kubectl -n redwood get events --sort-by='.lastTimestamp'
acme_prod_ops: We can run a replay in 30m if you want. Customer standing by.
maria_pager: Immediate mitigations: - Increase minpool (+10 nodes) for dedicated-us-east-2-min for 2h - Route small or test traffic to hosted-tier (redwood-small) as fallback - Enable hotpool/hotattach for this customer via feature flag - Ask eng-platform to pre-pull runtime image if image-pull backoff persists
jordan_sre: I'll roll back the minpool reduction and trigger hotpool scaling. Also create a short-lived canary using pre-warmed image redwood/runtime-warm:v2 to avoid pull+init latency.
kai_oncall: Notifying customer and asking them to pause replays. cc @emma_support for comms.
emma_support: Sent: \"We're rolling a temporary capacity increase and warm images. Please pause heavy replays for 15m while we validate.\" :white_check_mark:
deploybot: deploy started: set-minpool --pool dedicated-us-east-2-min --delta +10 --ttl 120m (deploy id dpl-8823)
2026-03-16T11:08:10Z deploybot: completed change in 45s.
jordan_sre: Hotpool creation succeeded. Attach queue drained after ~18s and p99 dropped toward 800-900ms. First-token latency still elevated for cold sessions but fewer timeouts now.
maria_pager: Follow-ups: - eng-platform: pre-pull runtime image for pool nodes during pre-warm windows - serving-runtime: investigate eager KV cache populate for first token - support: correlate auth 401s with attach failures/retries
emma_support: Opening OS ticket for auth correlation and asking customer for request-ids for the 401s.
acme_prod_ops: Resumed a low-intensity replay; metrics look better. We'll run a lower cadence replay tomorrow. Thanks.
jordan_sre: Postmortem bullets: 1) cost-driven minpool reduction removed warm capacity -> attach fanout 2) image-pull/backoff + kernel init = cold GPU penalty 3) autoscaler needs hysteresis to avoid simultaneous attach storms 4) consider per-customer admission control during bursts
maria_pager: Config proposals: - autoscaler: add randomized attach jitter (0-150ms) - provisioning: pre-pull window for priority pools - console: route-level prewarm toggle and customer hotpool opt-in
kai_oncall: Monitoring window: if p99 < 1s for 30m we'll resolve.
emma_support: Customer updated: \"Latency improved after your changes. We'll report if anything else.\" :+1:
acme_prod_ops: Thx all. Please add remediation PRs to follow-up doc.
jordan_sre: Filing RFC and runbook: RFC-attach-warmup-2026-03-16.
maria_pager: Adding to retrospective.
kai_oncall: last check 11:24 UTC: p95 210ms, p99 890ms, 0 auth 401s in last 10m. Closing thread.
